description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSalaryController class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends BaseViewEmployeeController and manages the salary-related functionalities for an employee, including preparing data for salary views and setting permissions. It utilizes various services and traits for Dependency Injection, internationalization, and Vue.js component rendering.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryController
classes.description: Controller handling employee salary view and settings, extending BaseViewEmployeeController with added functionalities to fetch salary-related data and permissions.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance via dependency injection container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the data and Vue component for rendering the employee salary view, including setting properties for currencies, paygrades, pay frequencies, and account types, as well as setting permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Specifies the data groups necessary for permission checks, specifically 'salary_details'.
